reply.text:
I hear you. Training can be a good place to put that energy, and showing up consistently when things are rough says something about you.

Before I build anything, I need to know what you're working with. What's your experience level, and what are you training for — strength, size, endurance, general fitness? And where do you train, and what equipment do you have access to? Looks like you haven't set up a profile yet. Head to Settings and fill in your experience, your training goal, where you train, and what equipment you have. Once that's done, come back and I'll build you something solid — something you can count on when things feel messy.
